column1: # Coverage index over all 38 Projection modules.
# `audited` = theorems whose exact name appears in an axiom report from
# Audit.lean (311) or Proto/ProtoAudit.lean (43). A theorem absent from
# both has NO kernel axiom report, which is not the same as being unproved.
# `defs`/`partial_defs`/`csimp` are executable surface: a partial def has no
# kernel theorem by construction, and a csimp equivalence is a separate
# obligation from the theorem it accelerates.
# `guards`/`evals` are COMPILED-EVALUATOR checks, not kernel results.
